location.zh: 中央車站旁的便利商店

goal.en: Find what you need and pay at the checkout.
goal.zh: 找到需要的東西，順利結帳。

background: small convenience store interior at night, narrow aisles with snacks and drinks in plain packaging, glass-door fridges, a checkout counter with a card reader, bright fluorescent lights

intro.en: On the way back to the hotel, you stop at a corner store. You need a toothbrush and some water.
intro.zh: 回飯店的路上，你走進一家便利商店。你需要一支牙刷和一些水。

intro.en: You check every aisle twice, but you can't find any toothbrushes.
intro.zh: 你把每個走道都找了兩遍，就是找不到牙刷。

lines.en: Hey. Let me know if you need anything.

choices.tip: Do you have...? 是在店裡問有沒有某樣商品最簡單的說法。

lines.en: Do I have a toothbrush? Uh, yeah. At home?
lines.zh: 我有沒有牙刷？呃，有啊，在家裡？

story.en: Tom tells you all about his new electric toothbrush. You learn a lot about his teeth, but you still don't know where the toothbrushes are.
story.zh: 湯姆跟你分享他新買的電動牙刷。你對他的牙齒瞭若指掌，卻還是不知道牙刷放在哪裡。

fail.why: 「有沒有……？」照中文說成 Have ... or not? 不是英文問句，對方會聽成在問他個人。在店裡問商品要說 Do you have toothbrushes?

story.en: Tom points with one finger and goes back to his phone. Somehow, the store feels ten degrees colder.
story.zh: 湯姆用一根手指指了一下，就繼續滑手機。不知怎麼的，店裡好像冷了十度。

fail.why: Hey, you! 加上只丟關鍵字，聽起來像在使喚人。問店員要用完整句子：Do you have toothbrushes?

lines.en: Sure, aisle three, next to the shampoo.
lines.zh: 有啊，第三排，洗髮精旁邊。

lines.en: You come back with a toothbrush and a bottle of water.
lines.zh: 你拿著一支牙刷和一瓶水回到櫃檯。

lines.en: That's six fifty. Do you need a bag?
lines.zh: 一共六塊五。需要袋子嗎？

choices.tip: No, thanks. I'm good. 是婉拒店員最自然的說法。

lines.en: You're not... need? Is that a yes or a no?
lines.zh: 你不是……需要？這是要還是不要？

story.en: Tom isn't sure, so he puts your two small items in a huge bag. You now own a bag much bigger than your shopping.
story.zh: 湯姆不確定，乾脆把你的兩樣小東西裝進一個超大袋子。現在你提著一個比商品大好幾倍的袋子。

fail.why: need 是一般動詞，否定要用 don't：I don't need one.，不能說 I'm not need.。最簡單的婉拒是 No, thanks.

choices.en: No need. I have two hands.

lines.en: You... have hands? Yeah, I can see that.

story.en: Tom stares at your hands, then at you. You walk out juggling a toothbrush and a water bottle, feeling very strange.
story.zh: 湯姆盯著你的手，再看看你。你兩手抓著牙刷和水瓶走出店門，覺得渾身不對勁。

fail.why: 「不用，我用手拿就好」直譯出來很奇怪。婉拒店員只要說 No, thanks. I'm good. 就夠了。

choices.tip: Card or cash? 直接回答 Card, please. 或 Cash, please.

lines.en: Brush the card? Like... clean it?
lines.zh: 刷卡片？是說……把它刷乾淨嗎？

story.en: Tom hands you a paper towel, thinking your card is dirty. The line behind you grows while you two sort it out.
story.zh: 湯姆以為你的卡髒了，遞給你一張紙巾。你們兩個搞清楚之前，後面的隊伍越排越長。

fail.why: 「刷卡」的「刷」不是 brush。回答 Card or cash? 只要說 Card, please.；想問能不能刷卡，說 Can I pay by card?

choices.en: Card. Can I buy train tickets here?
choices.zh: 刷卡。這裡可以買火車票嗎？

lines.en: Train tickets? Here? This is a corner store.
lines.zh: 火車票？在這裡？這是便利商店耶。

story.en: Tom looks at you like you asked to buy a car. You spend five minutes telling him how amazing Taiwanese convenience stores are.
story.zh: 湯姆看你的眼神，好像你要跟他買一台車。你花了五分鐘跟他介紹台灣的便利商店有多神。

fail.why: 台灣的便利商店可以買票、繳費、取包裹，但很多英語國家的便利商店只賣日常用品。結帳時先回答付款方式：Card, please.

lines.en: All done. Have a good night!

story.en: You walk back to the hotel with a new toothbrush, cold water, and the confidence to shop on your own.
story.zh: 你帶著新牙刷、冰涼的水，還有獨自購物的信心，走回飯店。

notes.explain: 在店裡問有沒有某樣商品。不要照中文說 Have ... or not?

example.zh: 你們有賣手機充電器嗎？

notes.explain: 婉拒店員提供的東西，例如袋子、收據，最自然的說法。

example.en: Do you need a receipt? No, thanks. I'm good.
example.zh: 需要收據嗎？不用了，謝謝。

notes.explain: need 是一般動詞，否定要用 don't，不能說 I'm not need.。同樣的還有 I don't want、I don't like。

example.en: I don't need a receipt, thanks.

notes.explain: 刷卡說 pay by card。結帳被問 Card or cash? 時，回答 Card, please. 或 Cash, please. 就好。

notes.zh: 這裡的便利商店功能比較單純
notes.explain: 台灣便利商店可以繳費、買票、取包裹，但很多英語國家的便利商店主要只賣零食、飲料和日用品。

example.en: Where can I buy train tickets?
example.zh: 請問哪裡可以買火車票？
